retired.native ds4: The Paperniuk ds4 runtime (ds4-unified, ds4-reference, ds4-swift-tokenizer) served all three models until 2026-11-13 and was retired after Splash-m1 passed every validation; see docs/NATIVE-RETIREMENT.md and the tag rollback/native-default-20261113.

splash-m1-1.6.1-ds1.description: Splash-m1 1.6.1-m1 with DwarfStar's patches (backends/splash-m1/patches): the qwen2 tokenizer profile (Swift) and exact BF16 planes (BF16S for widths of 64 but not 256, BF16 hyper-connections kept exact; Cyber). Built by scripts/backends/build_splash.sh from the 1.6.1-m1 source with Xcode 26.6's Metal toolchain; its Python, server and installer are the release's. directory is relative to the assets root, home to the data root.

splash-m1-1.6.1-ds2-telemetry.description: Splash-m1 1.6.1-m1 with DwarfStar's patches (backends/splash-m1/patches) plus the advanced-telemetry patches (backends/splash-m1/patches/telemetry): a bounded in-engine ring and a GET /telemetry endpoint that reports per-verify-cycle speculative-decode activity the aggregate /status cannot. Observational only; disabled unless polled; ds1 behaviour and output are unchanged (measured OFF/ADVANCED overhead within run-to-run noise). Built by scripts/backends/build_splash.sh --telemetry. directory is relative to the assets root, home to the data root.
